hero_sub: Protecting your investment while delivering five-star experiences for owners and guests across Koh Samui.
why_lead: We treat every villa as if it were our own — combining local expertise with the discretion and precision of true luxury hospitality.

pillars.title: Trusted Local Experts
pillars.text: A resident team on the island, on call, who know every villa, vendor, and microclimate of Koh Samui intimately.

pillars.title: Transparent Communication
pillars.text: Clear reporting and honest updates. You always know exactly how your property is performing and being cared for.

pillars.title: Preventative Maintenance
pillars.text: We anticipate issues before they become costly. Proactive care that protects value over the long term.

pillars.title: Luxury Hospitality Standards
pillars.text: Five-star service for owners and guests alike — every detail considered, nothing left to chance.

services_lead: A single, accountable team covering every aspect of villa ownership — so you can simply enjoy your home.

service_cards.title: Property Management
service_cards.text: End-to-end oversight of your villa, vendors, staff, and budgets.

service_cards.title: Villa Rentals
service_cards.text: Curated holiday rental management that maximises yield and protects the home.

service_cards.title: Concierge
service_cards.text: Private chefs, transfers, excursions and bespoke experiences on demand.

service_cards.title: Housekeeping
service_cards.text: Immaculate, hotel-grade cleaning and turnover by a trained resident team.

service_cards.title: Maintenance
service_cards.text: Skilled trades and preventative upkeep that keeps everything flawless.

service_cards.title: Pool & Garden
service_cards.text: Pristine water and lush landscaping, maintained on a precise schedule.

service_cards.title: Owner Reporting
service_cards.text: Clear monthly financials and performance — full transparency, always.

service_cards.title: Security Checks
service_cards.text: Regular inspections and monitoring for total peace of mind, year-round.

about_paragraph_1: Samui Luxury Stays was founded on a simple belief: that owning a villa in paradise should feel effortless. From our base in Koh Samui, we manage a select portfolio of distinguished homes for owners across the world.
about_paragraph_2: Our resident team blends genuine local knowledge with the discretion and precision expected by international clients. We are deliberately small — accountable, responsive, and personally invested in every home we hold.
about_sig_line1: A trusted partner, not a portal.
